I implemented `satisfies` and `maxSatisfying` in `src/range.ts` following the README, and `npm test` passes (3/3).

Beyond the given tests, I checked the README's examples (comparators, `^`/`~` with partial versions, hyphen ranges, empty sets) and the error cases (`>=`, `1.2.3.4`, `>= 1.2.3`, `1.x.3`, `^*`, `v1.2.3`, and so on). All behaved as specified. `maxSatisfying` validates the range and every listed version before matching, so it throws even for an empty list. Type-checking with `tsc` wasn't possible because the registry blocked it; Node's native TypeScript run succeeded.
